authority: Close the existing Shatterer's Crown offer-inclusion mechanism and author the smallest new deterministic Duskblade mediator justified by the measured source and capacity bottleneck. Do not search another existing scalar, Ward, Kindle, Afterimage or tested #524 package.

candidate.claimBoundary: The screen can authorise only an identity-safe research knob that guarantees the existing relic is included in an otherwise unchanged boss offer. It cannot authorise ownership, a score bonus, a content change or package admission.

definition.name: Shatterer's Crown
definition.text: Enemy glass runs thin: all facet gauges are 1 smaller. Enemies begin with 1 Fervor.

candidate.mediator: Dusk-only facet chips reaching the reduced facet threshold and producing Shatter
candidate.setup: At combat start the existing relic reduces every enemy facet_max by one and grants each enemy one Fervor.
candidate.sourceAlias: All 26 authored attack-card sources are one shared Dusk Shatter producer family; no source card is selected or tuned.

definition.claimBoundary: This is a deterministic policy-capacity calculation, not a causal trajectory or outcome estimate.
definition.offer: Shatterer's Crown plus an unordered pair from the other four current boss relics; all six pairs are enumerated without simulation.
definition.projectedActive: A robust selector that reached at least one boss boundary and produced at least one Shatter on the frozen current-main rectangle.
definition.robustDecliner: Strictly selects Crown for none of the six possible co-offer pairs.
definition.robustSelector: Strictly selects Crown for all six possible co-offer pairs.
definition.score: Exactly int(policy.relics[id] plus policy.relicDuskBonus for Shatterer's Crown), matching the frozen BalancePilot comparison.
definition.strictPairWin: Crown score is strictly greater than both co-offered relic scores. Ties never count as evidence because live choice depends on offer order.
